title: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands is vulnerable… (CVE-2026-115788)
description: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands have a vulnerability related to log forging when processing requests to create resources. This vulnerability can allow an attacker with low privileges to manipulate log entries, potentially impacting confidentiality and integrity of logged data. The vulnerability does not affect availability. It has a high severity score of 8.1 according to CVSS 3.1.
